content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Beaumont

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented project-management hours meet PMI's baseline. Beaumont's refining, healthcare, and port-logistics sectors regularly employ PMP-credentialed leaders; confirm your background qualifies before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. You'll receive detailed materials and instructor feedback throughout, preparing you rigorously for exam day.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35-hour course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI via their website. Include proof of your education, project experience, and Granite PM Academy's training completion. Pay PMI's exam fee at application. Allow time for PMI's review and approval before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides focused exam-preparation support, including practice questions, domain walkthroughs, and study strategies. The computerized exam tests your mastery of project integration, scope, schedule, cost, quality, resource, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing vendor once approved.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through project work, training, volunteer service, or exam retakes. PMI's online portal tracks your progress. Renew before expiration by submitting your PDUs and renewal fee to keep your credential active.
